ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Expired"), OR( ISBLANK( ExpirationDate ), ExpirationDate >= TODAY() ), NOT($CustomMetadata.Trigger_Framework_Config_CC__mdt.Quote.Bypass_Validation_CC__c), $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Quote cannot be marked as Expired unless the Expiration Date has passed.
